title: Cycle-Aware Autoencoder with Cross-SignalConsistency for Railway Door Anomaly Detection
abstract: arXiv:2609.39035v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Passenger access doors are safety-critical subsystems in railway vehicles, yet detecting abnormal door behavior in real operation is challenging because faults are rare, diverse, and often unlabeled. This paper addresses railway door condition monitoring as a cycle-level unsupervised anomaly detection problem, where each complete opening-dwell-closing cycle is treated as a single monitoring unit. We propose the Temporal Cycle-Aware Attention Autoencoder with Cross-Signal Consistency (TCAA-CS), trained exclusively on nominal cycles. It combines a dual-stream encoder that processes continuous physical measurements (position, current, voltage) and binary logical states (door-closed, door-locked) through separate 1D-CNN branches, an LSTM encoder with temporal attention pooling, and a triple hybrid anomaly score fusing reconstruction error, latent-space deviation, and phase-aware cross-signal consistency. translated_title: 面向铁路车门异常检测的具有跨信号一致性的循环感知自编码器
translated_abstract: 乘客通行门是铁路车辆中安全关键的子系统，然而在实际运营中检测车门的异常行为极具挑战性，因为故障罕见、形式多样且往往缺乏标签。本文将铁路车门状态监测视为一个循环级别的无监督异常检测问题，将每个完整的“开门—停留—关门”循环作为一个单独的监测单元。我们提出了具有跨信号一致性的时序循环感知注意力自编码器，该模型仅在正常循环数据上训练。它结合了双流编码器（通过独立的1D-CNN分支分别处理连续物理测量值（位置、电流、电压）和二值逻辑状态（门已关闭、门已锁闭））、带有时间注意力池化的LSTM编码器，以及融合重构误差、潜空间偏差和相位感知跨信号一致性的三重混合异常评分。该一致性项有助于识别（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了一种具有跨信号一致性的时序循环感知注意力自编码器（TCAA-CS），以每个完整车门循环为监测单元，仅在正常数据上训练，通过融合重构误差、潜空间偏差与相位感知跨信号一致性的混合评分，实现铁路车门的无监督异常检测。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes TCAA-CS, a temporal cycle-aware attention autoencoder trained only on nominal door cycles, which treats each opening-dwell-closing cycle as a monitoring unit and performs unsupervised railway door anomaly detection via a hybrid score fusing reconstruction error, latent-space deviation, and phase-aware cross-signal consistency.
